sentences.text: For a government, the most attainable goal is not to reverse the trend but to rekindle interest in critical reading, for example through the renovation of a library space that can encourage careful study.
sentences.translation: 对政府而言,最可实现的目标不是逆转趋势,而是重新点燃人们对批判性阅读的兴趣,例如通过翻新图书馆空间来鼓励静心学习。

sentences.text: A university should therefore neither forfeit its physical building nor neglect digital innovation, since both can serve the fulfillment of a student need; after all, a library can be a microcosm of the whole campus, and the legislative duty to fund it may never disappear.
sentences.translation: 因此,大学既不应放弃实体建筑,也不应忽视数字创新,因为两者都能服务于学生需求的实现;毕竟,图书馆可以是整个校园的缩影,为其提供资金的立法责任也可能永远不会消失。

grammar.name: neither... nor... 结构
grammar.note: neither forfeit... nor neglect... 表示"既不……也不……",用于陈述不应采取的两类行为。
grammar.example: We should neither ignore data nor trust it blindly.
grammar.exampleCn: 我们既不应忽视数据,也不应盲目相信数据。

grammar.name: since 引导原因状语从句
grammar.note: since 说明"二者兼顾"的理由,呼应前文结论。

grammar.name: 插入语 after all
grammar.note: after all 表示"毕竟",引出常识性论据,增强说服力。

grammar.name: 名词化结构
grammar.note: the legislative duty to fund it 与 the fulfillment of a student need 均为名词化表达,体现学术语体的正式性。

lessonGrammar.name: 图表描述句式
lessonGrammar.note: The line chart below can illustrate... 是雅思图表作文的标准开头,先点明图表类型与主要内容。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The line chart below can illustrate the dramatic growth of digital library use between 2015 and 2025, a trend that an observer should study with care.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 下面的折线图可以说明 2015 至 2025 年间数字图书馆使用的急剧增长,这一趋势值得观察者认真研究。

lessonGrammar.name: 同位语补充说明
lessonGrammar.note: a trend that an observer should study 对前面的整体趋势作补充说明,其中 that 引导定语从句。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The line chart below can illustrate the dramatic growth of digital library use between 2015 and 2025, a trend that an observer should study with care.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 下面的折线图可以说明 2015 至 2025 年间数字图书馆使用的急剧增长,这一趋势值得观察者认真研究。

lessonGrammar.name: 时间范围表达
lessonGrammar.note: between 2015 and 2025 说明数据的时间跨度,是图表描述必备要素。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The line chart below can illustrate the dramatic growth of digital library use between 2015 and 2025, a trend that an observer should study with care.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 下面的折线图可以说明 2015 至 2025 年间数字图书馆使用的急剧增长,这一趋势值得观察者认真研究。

lessonGrammar.name: According to 引出数据来源
lessonGrammar.note: According to the data 表明数据的出处,使论述客观可信,是图表作文的核心句式。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: According to the data, electronic download rose from two million to fifteen million a year, an increase of more than seven hundred per cent, while a visit to a physical reading room fell by more than half.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 根据数据,电子下载量从每年两百万次上升到一千五百万次,增幅超过百分之七百,而实体阅览室的访问量下降了一半以上。

lessonGrammar.name: from... to... 数据变化表达
lessonGrammar.note: rose from two million to fifteen million 用 from... to... 描述数据变化范围;fell by more than half 用 by 描述变化幅度。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: According to the data, electronic download rose from two million to fifteen million a year, an increase of more than seven hundred per cent, while a visit to a physical reading room fell by more than half.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 根据数据,电子下载量从每年两百万次上升到一千五百万次,增幅超过百分之七百,而实体阅览室的访问量下降了一半以上。
